During midlife, it might adjust to address challenges like career changes, empty nesting, and the health of loved ones. In later life, hope shifts towards maintaining good health, leaving a legacy, and staying connected with loved ones. It becomes more resilient, grounded in the knowledge that resilience and adaptability have seen us through previous challenges. Throughout these stages, hope evolves, providing a beacon of optimism and direction, even as it adjusts to accommodate the realities and complexities of each phase of life.
